request.query: Coefficient extraction under the algebra equivalence between polynomials on Option sigma and univariate polynomials over MvPolynomial sigma using Finsupp optionElim

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv
items.type:
(R : Type u) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f

items.name: AlgebraicIndependent.mvPolynomialOptionEquivPolynomialAdjoin
items.type:
{ι : Type u} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    {A : Type v} →
      {x : ι → A} →
        [inst : CommRing R] →
          [inst_1 : CommRing A] →
            [inst_2 : Algebra R A] →
              AlgebraicIndependent R x → MvPolynomial (Option ι) R ≃+* Polynomial ↥(Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x))

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_apply
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_X_some
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (x : S₁),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X (some x)) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X x)

items.name: MvPolynomial.image_support_finSuccEquiv
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {i : ℕ},
  Finset.image (Finsupp.cons i) (((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) f).coeff i).support = {m ∈ f.support | m 0 = i}
